notes.title: Demo Version 0.3.0 Small Update: LongSword, Dual Blades & Great Sword Enhanced
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335069/56c40d93d6a69dc88e5b1222ec94b7cbca858514.png"]Greetings, Gladiator Cats! We’re rolling out a small update for Demo Version 0.3.0. The key changes this time focus on buffing the LongSword, Dual Blades, and Great Sword. Additionally, the BeeMoth has taken yet another nerf, and the drop rate of Boar materials has seen a huge increase—welcome back to all players who got stuck on the BeeMoth to give it another shot! Check out the detailed update notes below.
Weapons:
LongSword:

Failed Iaido Slash no longer depletes Spirit Blade.

Foresight Slash and Spirit Blade Spin now support direction adjustment.

Jump Slash has received effect optimizations, and its damage now includes partial homing.

Dual Blades:

Spiral Jump Slash now grants Super Armor and reduces damage taken by 20%.

Great Sword:

Leaping Strike now comes with extended invincibility frames.
Bosses:
Low-Rank BeeMoth has been nerfed once again.

The drop rate of Low-Rank Boar materials has been significantly increased.

Health of Slimes and Enraged Slimes has been reduced.

New attack effects have been added for certain Bosses.
Others:
The time limit for achieving Rank A has been adjusted from 2 minutes 30 seconds to 3 minutes.

New player onboarding process has been optimized.

Added a one-click "Abandon Quest" function.

Weapon icons have been optimized.
Bug Fixes:
Fixed the issue where accepting quests simultaneously in co-op would cause quest overwrites.

We will continue to improve it in the future. Welcome to leave your playtest feedback in the comments on the Demo page!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2.96: NPC Sprite, Tutorial Optimization, & Longsword Damage Fix
notes.notes:
Greetings, Gladiator Cats! We’re rolling out another update to make your Demo experience even better—again! This update mainly includes improvements to NPC sprites, optimized new player tutorials, fixes to the Longsword "Jump Slash" damage, and more. Hope you continue to have a blast!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335069/879ce68833a574b0017ee1615af222c56a604ec4.png"]

Update Details:
[olist]
Enhanced sprites for all NPCs

Optimized new player onboarding

Added button move displays in the bottom-left window

Fixed Longsword "Jump Slash" damage (increased by roughly double)

New prop added: AntiAirRocket (BeeMoth says nothing)

Lots of other optimizations!
[/olist]

notes.title: 0.2.9 Demo Small-Scale Update: LongSword Optimization & Lower-Rank Terrafist
notes.notes:
Gladiator Meows, hello! To bring you a better Demo experience, we welcome  another update. This update mainly adds the lower-rank Rockhammer Dragon and its weapons, optimizes the Katana, and launches a speedrun leaderboard and achievements. Hope you have fun!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335069/b3119a5d9ebb354fc6b2d574094d5b1c3f60cd60.png"]

0.2.9 Update Content:

1. Added lower-rank Terrafist and upper/lower-rank weapons of the Terrafist series.

2. Renovated the Colosseum for a more immersive fighting experience (probably?).

3. Speedrun leaderboard (for upper-rank bosses only) and achievements launched.

4. Optimized LongSword operations and Rising Dragon Slash special effects.

5. Added key remapping function, new keyboard and mouse controls, and optimized controller effects.

6. Slow-motion effect for defeating bosses.

7. And... more optimization content!

notes.title: 0.2.62 Demo Small-Scale Update: Terrafist Now Available!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Gladiator Cats! After over two weeks since the Demo launched, we’ve accumulated plenty of feedback, and it’s time for an update. This update primarily introduces the hidden boss Terrafist, adjusts the difficulty of early bosses, and includes other optimizations:

Terrafist
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335069/982e1f377fc3bc6087f3c270b7b3e8ba8c91d1b4.png
"The living bulldozer. Loves pounding meows, deals (extreme) damage—Gladiator Cats, be cautious!"
Unlock Condition: Complete the high-rank Moth Wasp with an S rank to unlock the high-rank Terrafist quest.

Boss Difficulty Curve Adjustment
Reduced the difficulty of early bosses based on your feedback to make it easier for new players to dive in!

Blacksmith Bundle
Uncle Blacksmith Cat’s equipment isn’t selling—defeat a Slime to get a free piece of armor directly!

UI Interface Optimization
Enhanced the display of various UI interfaces for a more polished look!

Other Key Minor Changes
*Player movement speed up/down during attacks adjusted to 0.6x.
*Good news for dual-blades users: Spiral Slash movement speed increased.
*Optimized monster knockdown value changes in multiplayer.
*Health bars and damage numbers can now be toggled in the menu.
*Only the host can end missions.
*Added chat emojis.

Bug Fixes
*Fixed an issue where Rat Coins could be claimed multiple times.
*Fixed a problem where damage became 0 if a jump exceeded a certain range.
*Fixed BGM synchronization for players not participating in combat.

Wish you all have a great time! If you need to team up for online play, welcome to join our Discord.

notes.title: Demo Version Will Soon Be Available
notes.notes:
A brand-new Steam demo is about to start (currently under review). Join our Discord community to be a cyber supervisor and enjoy the life of hunting cats!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335069/7e59a666dbd1118b547378dc3b09d63a4e3ea660.png
Game Introduction
 is developed by a three-person team inspired by our shared passion for the Monster Hunter series. As long-time fans of hunting-action games, we aim to create a cooperative hunting experience with appropriately simplified weapon mechanics, accessible boss difficulty, and enhanced prop usage – all to introduce more players to this thrilling genre.

In the game, you play as a middle-aged hunter cat who gets laid off and becomes a gladiator to make ends meet. Grab your weapons and team up with fellow cats to battle colossal bosses in the arena!

Demo Content
・4-player online co-op boss battles
・All 6 weapon types: Sword & Shield, Longsword, Gun, Greatsword, Dual Blades, Harp
・Early bosses: Training Slime, lower and upper-tier Wild Boars and Moth Bees
・Craftable gear sets: Slime, Wild Boar, Moth Bee, and Rat uncle(NPC) armor/weapons
・Multiple usable props: Traps, explosive barrels, healing potions, basketball bombs, grilled fish buffs
・Cat Customization: Choose from various fur patterns. An in-game stylist NPC lets you redesign your appearance anytime and leap back into battle!

The game is still in development – your feedback matters! Planned full-release features include more bosses, props, weapons, gear, and a Cat Meal system. Join us in shaping this adventure!
